confidence_notes: The restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from Numbeo-based figures (June 2026, via Expatica), converted at an assumed rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR. I did not look up that conversion rate. I found no reliable cocktail or wine-by-the-glass price. The cocktail is estimated at roughly 3x the local beer price, and the wine glass at roughly 1.4x beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings, and Seville's summer and event-season prices vary widely. The FX rate is the 18 November 2026 RBA 4pm rate, the latest one confirmed on RBA pages. A 19 November figure appeared on one page, but it may be partial or cached.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seville is a mid-sized Andalusian tourist city. It is roughly 20% cheaper than Madrid and Barcelona for food and drink, according to cost-of-living sources.
